name: L.A. Co-op Lab
description: Supports the development and growth of worker cooperatives in Los Angeles through education, technical assistance, and community-building, aiming to build democratic economic power in historically excluded communities. Grew out of a 2015 Antioch University graduate capstone project exploring how to build local capacity for worker ownership. Offers workshops (in-person and via a self-paced online academy), business/financial/governance development assistance, office hours for prospective co-op developers, and bilingual (English/Spanish) educational materials. A New Economy Coalition member organization.
